cell:-2.25,-103.75.name: At-risk fishing effort
cell:-2.25,-103.75.desc: A 2.5° cell of ocean in which the published model attributes 3,714,493 kW-hours of fishing effort to vessels it scored high-risk for forced labour, 93.79% of all effort recorded in this cell. Gear: drifting longlines,squid jigger. This is not a vessel and nobody here is identified. The authors anonymised every hull in their release, and on a method contested in the same journal that was the right call. What the cell says is where the model puts unusual amounts of at-risk effort — useful for grasping the scale and the geography, useless for pointing at a ship. McDonald et al., PNAS 2021, 2018 effort. Compare it with the named-vessel layer, which is the opposite: few points, each an official designation against an identified ship.
